evidence.observation: Smooth, gradual warming of mid/upper column (T703 79.1→82.3 °C) consistent with progressing batch distillation
Top temperatures stable ~67.2-67.8 °C, stable overhead cut
Reflux ~0.32 L/h and distillate ~0.52 L/h steady; ratio noisy but around 6
Differential pressures steady (~0.8 / ~2.0 mbar) and system pressure ~598 mbar, no flooding or blockage

args.missing_evidence: A composition measurement (e.g., GC of distillate/bottoms) to assess separation; also note T701 reads ~356-359 °C, far above other stages — plausible reboiler heater/sensor scale, would confirm with reboiler setpoint.
